draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.88, the 189th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 19th of 22 at RB. He lasted until pick 251, well after his grade rank (189th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Mike Gillislee. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (94th percentile). College production: 647 rushing yards in 2021, 19th of 22 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions (reserve). 51 career games and 42 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2023. Weak spots: broken tackles 3 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 running back who played: 563 scrimmage yards against a median of 411, above the norm.
